basis: User listening review of some cross-tape samples; general working preference, not approval of every sample or tape.

residual_hum.basis: User requested general adoption after the enhanced T510083 CH22 hum-removal comparison.
residual_hum.scope: Default shared stage-03 speech cleanup and future review generation; existing reports remain frozen. Not full-tape streaming validation or approval of every voice/channel.

preservation_intent: Preserve voices and noise inherent to the historical tapes; prioritize removal of digitization-introduced artifacts rather than making the recordings artificially quiet.
limitations: The current tonal detector and quiet-window broadband filter classify signal characteristics, not historical origin. Tonal noise is not proven to originate in digitization; broadband noise is not proven to originate on tape. A 3 dB reduction cap limits processing but does not selectively preserve tape-origin noise.
individual_sample_ratings: Not supplied; existing review ratings and per-sample verification remain unchanged.
